retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, grainy monochrome image featuring a central figure diving into water with a solarized, ethereal glow and hand-drawn decorative typography.
excludeWhen: clean modern sans-serif layouts are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A vertical, central figure in a diving pose, captured in a high-contrast, grainy, blue-tinted monochrome style that mimics solarization or a cyanotype. The figure appears to be entering dark water, creating a splash at the bottom, while the background is a dark, textured void with subtle stippling.
coreVisualRelationships: Central figure vertically bisecting the composition
High contrast between glowing highlights and deep shadows
Textured grain throughout the entire image surface
Typography placed in the upper left and center right quadrants
coreInvariants: Solarized glow around the human figure
Deep teal or cyan-tinted monochrome palette
Heavy film grain and stippled texture

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A human figure in a diving arc occupies the central vertical axis, scaled to approximately 60% of the frame height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright, glowing torso and arms of the diver against the dark background.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the downward arc of the diver from the top center toward the splash at the bottom, then moves to the typography in the corners.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive dark, textured negative space surrounds the central figure, creating a sense of isolation and depth.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal and midnight blue for the background and shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pale cyan and off-white for the glowing highlights of the figure.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Subtle mid-tone teal for the grain and texture.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with extreme value contrast between the highlights and the deep shadows.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Irregular, hand-drawn serif and display characters
letterConstructionRules: Variable line weights with a hand-inked feel
Intentional misalignment and varying character heights
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'H' features an extended crossbar that connects to adjacent letters
The 'B' includes a decorative dot inside the counter

composition.relationshipToImage: placed in the negative space next to the diver

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between raw, expressive hand-lettering and delicate, spaced-out formal italics.

preserve: Top-left placement for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the organic, decorative flow of the primary text
Provides the necessary delicate serif contrast for the subtitle

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a grainy, high-contrast monochrome image in deep teal tones. The subject is a human figure diving vertically into water, creating a splash at the bottom. Apply a solarization effect so the figure glows with bright cyan highlights against a dark, stippled background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add hand-drawn, decorative uppercase lettering in the top left corner with irregular weights and curling terminals. Add a small, lowercase italic serif subtitle with wide letter spacing in the center-right negative space.

verificationChecks: Is the image monochromatic with a teal/cyan tint?
Does the diver have a solarized, glowing outline?
Is the main text hand-drawn and decorative?
Is the subtitle widely spaced and italicized?

adjustableVariables: Degree of decorative flourish in the lettering
mustRedesign: Avoid using standard modern fonts for the main title
Do not use a clean, digital photographic look; must be textured
postGenerationChecks: Check for the presence of heavy stippled grain
Ensure the diver's pose is a vertical arc
Verify the teal/cyan monochrome color balance
Confirm the typography is placed in the correct quadrants
recipe.reuseFormula: Solarized Diver + Grainy Cyanotype + Hand-Drawn Art Nouveau Lettering
